headline: SEBI warns Cupid Breweries over takeover rule breach
summary: SEBI issued an administrative warning to Cupid Breweries & Distilleries for violating Regulation 22(2A) of Takeover Regulations by crediting shares directly instead of an escrow account.

headline: Biocon to host analyst meets in Mumbai on Nov 17-18
summary: Biocon Limited will engage with analysts and institutional investors at two major conferences in Mumbai. The company confirms no unpublished price sensitive information will be disclosed.

headline: Bharti Hexacom to host investor meets in Nov 2026
summary: Bharti Hexacom Limited will participate in CITIC CLSA India Forum and Morgan Stanley Asia Pacific Summit in November 2026.

headline: Intense Technologies appoints Namrata K. Shaw as CS
summary: Intense Technologies Limited appointed Ms. Namrata K. Shaw as Company Secretary and Compliance Officer effective November 12, 2026, following the resignation of Mrs. Pratyusha Podugu.

headline: Edelweiss co-founder Venkatachalam resigns as Vice Chairman
summary: Venkatachalam Ramaswamy resigned as Director and Vice Chairman of Edelweiss Financial Services on November 11, 2026. He also requested reclassification from Promoter to Public shareholder.

headline: Codelco and Adani Group sign MOU on copper exploration
summary: Codelco and Adani Group are said to have signed a memorandum of understanding focused on copper exploration, marking a potential cross-border mining collaboration.

headline: Parag Milk Foods Q2FY27 Revenue Up 23% to ₹1,241 Crore
summary: Parag Milk Foods reported a 23% YoY rise in Q2FY27 revenue to ₹1,241 crore, driven by volume growth and premium mix. EBITDA grew 37% YoY excluding one-offs.

headline: Stocks to Watch Today: Bajaj Finance, Tata Power, Cupid, Hindustan Copper
summary: Bajaj Finance rallies on QIP launch, while Cupid surges after signing a major retail deal. Tata Power and Hindustan Copper also in focus amid capex and earnings updates.

headline: Zydus completes 50% JV with Sunshine Healthcare
summary: Zydus Lifesciences finalized its joint venture with Sunshine Healthcare Lanka by subscribing to 50% equity in ZyduS Sunshine on November 11, 2026.

headline: Adani's Kutch Copper signs MoU with Codelco for Chile exploration
summary: Kutch Copper Ltd, a subsidiary of Adani Enterprises, signed a strategic MoU with Chile's state-owned Codelco to explore the Kaburkaala copper project in the Calama belt.

headline: Shreeji Translogistics promoter buys 0.04% stake
summary: Chandrika Rajnikant Shah, a member of the promoter group of Shreeji Translogistics Ltd, acquired 28,994 shares in the open market on November 11, 2026.

headline: HFCL wins export deals worth ₹834.36 crore
summary: HFCL secured export orders valued at ₹834.36 crore (about $88.94 million) for optical fiber cables, marking a significant international business win for the company.

headline: Powergrid wins Karnataka transmission project
summary: Power Grid Corporation secured a Karnataka transmission project with annual charges of ₹243.34 crore. In FY27, TBCB additions across 11 projects raised total annual charges to ₹8,106.97 crore.

headline: Waaree Energies clarifies US solar import news
summary: Waaree Energies addressed reports on US solar import scrutiny, stating no new penalties or financial impact. Past shipments faced customs duties only, and its Texas manufacturing facility continues to operate normally.

headline: TACC signs MoU for 40,000 tonne anode supply
summary: HEG Advanced Materials subsidiary TACC Limited signed a non-binding MoU with a global lithium-ion cell manufacturer for up to 40,000 tonnes of synthetic anode active material.

headline: Indian rupee opens at 84.73 vs dollar
summary: The Indian rupee opened at 93.73 against the US dollar, compared to the previous close of 93.69, reflecting a marginal depreciation in the domestic currency.

headline: India 10-year bond yield eases to 7.2034%
summary: India's 10-year benchmark government bond yield declined to 7.2034% from the previous close of 7.2139%, reflecting a marginal easing in borrowing costs.

headline: Nomura maintains Buy on GE Shipping, target ₹1,995
summary: Nomura maintains Buy on GE Shipping with a target price of ₹1,995, citing in-line Q2FY27 results, strong NAV growth, and raised FY27-28 PAT estimates of 11% and 7%.

headline: Matrimony.com expects double-digit revenue growth
summary: Matrimony.com expects double-digit revenue growth in Q3FY27 and throughout the current year, with similar growth anticipated for the next year.

headline: LGT Global Hospitality replaces CS Ankita Jain with Dharshini S
summary: LGT Global Hospitality Limited announced the resignation of Company Secretary Ankita Jain effective November 15, 2026. Dharshini S has been appointed to fill the vacancy starting November 16, 2026.

headline: Vardhman Polytex settles IBC case with Bhagwati Cotton
summary: Vardhman Polytex Limited reached an amicable settlement with operational creditor Bhagwati Cotton Company regarding IBC proceedings initiated in October 2026.

headline: Indegene sees ₹72.13 crore block trade on BSE
summary: A block trade of approximately 1,161,122 shares of Indegene was executed on BSE at ₹621.25 per share, totalling ₹72.13 crore.

headline: Yatharth Hospital gets CCI nod for ₹31,500 crore preferential issue
summary: Yatharth Hospital & Trauma Care Services Ltd received CCI approval for a ₹31,500 crore preferential issue to Rasmalai Limited, representing a 24.87% stake.

headline: Creative Newtech signs AT&T brand license deal
summary: Creative Newtech enters a strategic brand license agreement with AT&T for technology infrastructure products, expanding its portfolio across India and international markets.

headline: LTM launches AI-QEM in IBM Quantum Catalog
summary: LTM becomes the first Global Systems Integrator to publish a function in IBM's Quantum Functions Catalog, offering AI-powered error mitigation.

headline: Max Financial to host investor meet on Nov 17
summary: Max Financial Services senior management will participate in the Avendus Spark INDX conference in Mumbai on November 17, 2026. The event involves group meetings with no unpublished price-sensitive information intended for discussion.

headline: eClerx to acquire RegEdge LLC for up to $12 million
summary: eClerx Services Ltd's subsidiary eClerx LLC signed a deal to acquire RegEdge LLC, a US-based risk and regulatory consulting firm, for up to USD 12 million.

headline: Petronet LNG to hold analyst meets in Mumbai
summary: Petronet LNG will participate in JM Financial and CLSA conferences in Mumbai on November 17-18, 2026. No price-sensitive info to be shared.

headline: Kirloskar Electric gets BSE, NSE listing approval
summary: Kirloskar Electric Company Ltd received listing approval from BSE and NSE for a preferential issue of 34.68 lakh equity shares to promoter group at ₹115.34 per share.

headline: Shilchar Technologies to host investor meet Nov 17
summary: Shilchar Technologies Limited will engage with institutional investors and fund managers on November 17, 2026, in Mumbai. The physical interaction is scheduled at the Avendus Spark INDX Annual Investor Conference.

headline: Smruthi Organics secures Brazilian GMP certificate
summary: Smruthi Organics Ltd received the Brazilian GMP Certificate from ANVISA for Levanlodipine Besylate at Unit II. The certification, valid until October 2028, strengthens its regulatory presence in Brazil.

headline: Paras Defence to host investor meet in Singapore
summary: Paras Defence and Space Technologies will meet institutional investors in Singapore on November 16-17, 2026, as part of the India Corporate Day.

headline: CIE Automotive India sets investor meet dates
summary: CIE Automotive India Ltd scheduled analyst and institutional investor meets for November 16 and 26, 2026, in Mumbai.

headline: Aditya Birla Sun Life AMC to host investor meet Nov 18
summary: Aditya Birla Sun Life AMC Limited will participate in the Avendus Spark INDX Annual Investor Conference on November 18, 2026, in Mumbai.

headline: Uzbekistan Airways picks RateGain AirGain
summary: Uzbekistan Airways selects RateGain's AirGain platform for real-time fare intelligence to support its fleet expansion and international network growth.

headline: SBI Life Insurance block trade on BSE
summary: A block trade of approximately 400,003 shares of SBI Life Insurance was executed on BSE at ₹1,814.50 per share, amounting to ₹72.58 crore.

headline: Lupin launches Ranibizumab biosimilar in Europe
summary: Lupin's partner Sandoz launched Ranlusp ec, a biosimilar of Ranibizumab, across Europe excluding Germany on November 12, 2026.

headline: Suven to present 7 CNS drug posters at SfN 2026
summary: Suven Life Sciences will showcase seven scientific posters on its CNS pipeline at Neuroscience 2026 in Washington DC, covering Alzheimer's, schizophrenia, and depression.

headline: Repco Home Finance RTA address change
summary: Repco Home Finance announces KFin Technologies' new corporate office address effective December 1, 2026. Investors must direct correspondence to the new Hyderabad location.

headline: Anna Infrastructures Q2FY27: Net loss of ₹4.68 lacs
summary: Anna Infrastructures posted a net loss of ₹4.68 lacs for Q2FY27, reversing from a profit of ₹0.05 lacs in Q2FY26. Total income fell to ₹9.22 lacs from ₹12.59 lacs YoY.

headline: Emerald Finance signs DSA deal with Utkarsh SFB
summary: Emerald Finance Limited has entered into a Direct Selling Agent agreement with Utkarsh Small Finance Bank to source gold loans across India.

headline: Leap India to host investor meet on Nov 17
summary: Leap India Ltd will participate in the Avendus Spark INDX Annual Investor Conference in Mumbai on November 17, 2026. The event is scheduled from 9 am to 5 pm.

headline: Kalyani Strategic Systems unveils 120mm mortar system
summary: Kalyani Strategic Systems, a Bharat Forge subsidiary, has unveiled a 120mm Rapid Attack Mortar System designed for the Indian military, emphasising quick response, mobility, and crew safety.

headline: Nava Q2 profit jumps 138% to ₹3.1B
summary: Nava reported a 138% surge in consolidated net profit to ₹3.1 billion for Q2, driven by 25% revenue growth and margin expansion.

headline: Maruti Suzuki sets investor meetings for Nov 17-19
summary: Maruti Suzuki India Limited has scheduled investor meetings for November 17, 18, and 19, 2026. The company notified exchanges under SEBI LODR regulations, noting dates are subject to change.

headline: SI Capital Q2FY27: PAT falls to ₹4 lakh
summary: SI Capital & Financial Services reported a 63% YoY drop in Q2FY27 net profit to ₹4.00 lakh. Revenue rose 16% YoY, but costs surged, compressing margins significantly.

headline: Sterling & Wilson extends arbitration suspension
summary: Sterling & Wilson Renewable Energy Limited extended the suspension of ICC arbitration with TSGF SPA until March 31, 2027, following a conditional settlement agreement.
